description: Read entities from a FIWARE context broker (Orion, Orion-LD, Scorpio, Stellio) over NGSI-LD or NGSIv2 and return them as flat records (id, type, each attribute value with its unit, lat/lon, observedAt) — the same shape the viewer's twin panel binds to IFC elements. The request goes from this machine straight to the broker. Use it to see what live data a broker offers before linking it to a model.

context.description: JSON-LD @context URL (NGSI-LD), for short attribute names.

tenant.description: NGSILD-Tenant / Fiware-Service, if the broker uses one.

type.description: Entity type, e.g. AirQualityObserved, ParkingSpot. NGSI-LD needs one.

name: read_fiware_entities
title: Read entities from a FIWARE context broker
